units.source_text: 蹑足走到大书院后面，我穿上早已备好的草鞋，

en.t: Stepping quietly around behind the great study, I put on the straw sandals that had already been prepared,

units.source_text: 迎着(氵蒙)(氵蒙)的细雨，沿鹿苑寺里恻的水沟向工地走去。

en.t: and, facing the misty drizzle, walked along the drainage ditch inside Rokuonji toward the construction site.

units.source_text: 工地上没有堆放木材，弥漫着一股散落一地的锯木子被雨水淋湿后发出的气味儿，寺庙买来的稻草都贮藏在这里。

en.t: No timber was stacked at the site; the smell of sawdust scattered over the ground and soaked by the rain hung in the air, and all the straw the temple had bought was stored here.
They bought forty bundles at a time.

units.source_text: 但是，已经用得差不多，今晚只剩下三捆堆放在那里。

en.t: But most of it had already been used, and tonight only three bundles remained piled there.
